Market selloffs are becoming increasingly selective:

Over the last 20 S&P 500 down days, an average of 239 stocks finished positive, the highest reading on record.

This is TRIPLE the levels seen during the 2022 bear market and nearly double the 20-year average of 133 stocks.

items.headline:
A finance influencer was just stabbed by a follower who lost money on his stock picks.

Police say the man invested based on the YouTuber’s videos and blamed him for major losses.

He’s now under arrest on suspicion of attempted murder after stabbing the influencer several times
